text:
maria_cs: Customer ACME corp reports sudden 403 on embeddings and rerank calls for a service account that previously worked. They say this started after an IdP config change last week. Attached a snippet of the error:

maria_cs: ```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{
  \"error\": { \"message\": \"insufficient_scope: embeddings.generate required\" }
}
```

sam_eng: Thanks — can you paste the raw JWT or decoded claims (redact jti/iss if needed)? Need to check scopes vs entitlements mapping.

maria_cs: Pasted decoded claims (redacted):
```
{
  \"sub\": \"svc-acme-01\",
  \"exp\": 1710000000,
  \"entitlements\": [1001, 1002],
  \"aud\": \"redwood-inference\",
  \"iat\": 1709990000
}
```

devon_sre: Whoa — entitlements are numeric codes not scope strings. Our auth layer expects a flat list like [\"inference:generate\",\"embeddings:write\",\"rerank:score\"]. Did ACME change their mapping or did the provisioner change?

ava_idp: Quick summary from IdP side: we rolled out a new compact mapping where downstream claim name is still `entitlements` but values are integer IDs (to align with internal role ids). It was intentional. We added a translation table in the SSO sync service but that only affects SAML assertions, not the short-lived tokens issued via the provisioning webhook last week.

sam_eng: That explains it. Our token validator does an exact membership check against allowed scope strings. Numeric codes will never match and produce 403. Two parts: 1) short-term workaround for ACME, 2) long-term fix in our token mapping layer.

maria_cs: Customer asks for workaround asap. They need embeddings calls unblocked for a scheduled nightly job.

devon_sre: Workaround options:
- Option A: Ask IdP to revert the compact mapping for service-account tokens (fast but requires IdP change).
- Option B: Our side add a translation table in the provisioner that maps numeric entitlements -> scope strings at token mint time. This needs a tiny patch and config; can be rolled as a hotfix.
- Option C: Update a tenant-level role mapping in Console: an interim mapping where tenant admin maps entitlement 1001 -> embeddings:write and 1002 -> inference:generate. This is lower-risk if we expose mapping UI quickly.

sam_eng: Repro steps I ran locally to confirm (useful for eng triage):
1) use token with numeric entitlements header:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ey..." -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
```
2) server log shows failure at claim check: `allowed_scopes.contains("embeddings:write") == false`
3) patched local validator to translate 1001->"embeddings:write" and retry -> success
```
200 OK { \"data\": [...] }
```

ava_idp: I can provision a temporary token with string scopes for ACME in ~15m. If you want the customer unblocked immediately, that is fastest.

maria_cs: ACME said temporary token is fine for tonight. Please do that and I will confirm.

deploy-bot: deploy/apply-config #2789: provisioner/entitlement-translation added mapping for tenant-level override (staged). CI passed.

devon_sre: Note for the infra/ops ticket: even after we add translation in provisioner, we should add telemetry alert when tokens contain numeric entitlements so we can identify other tenants.

sam_eng: Agreed. Next steps:
- Ava to issue temporary string-scoped token for ACME (ETA 15m)
- Maria to confirm with customer
- Sam/Devon to schedule a weekly hotfix to add a default global mapping table and a tenant-mapping UI. Add alert for numeric entitlements.

maria_cs: Confirmed with ACME: temp token from @ava_idp works, embeddings job ran successfully. Customer relieved. They want permanent fix before next rotation.

ava_idp: Will file IdP change request and share mapping table. I'll also add a flag on the provisioner to translate numeric entitlements during token mint.

sam_eng: I created GH issue #4123 to implement translation in token validation path and console mapping UI. Assigning to eng-identity team.

maria_cs: Thanks all — marking this thread resolved from CS side. I'll keep the customer posted about the GH issue and timeline.

devon_sre: Logging note: added one-off rule to detect entitlements as non-string values and emit `auth.claims.format_mismatch` metric.

maria_cs: :white_check_mark:
